class.name: TrenchbroomLocalConfig
class.brief_description: Local editor configuration for Trenchbroom export paths.
class.description: Local machine project-wide settings for Trenchbroom exports. Do not create a new resource for each project; use the premade [code]{defaults_path}/trenchbroom_local_config.tres[/code] entry point from your [code]blazium/trenchbroom/defaults_path[/code] ProjectSettings checkout. Settings are stored in [code]user://trenchbroom_config.json[/code] when exported via the inspector Export button. Export local settings before using [method TrenchbroomGameConfig.export_file] or [method NetRadiantCustomGamePackConfig.export_file], which read paths through [method TrenchbroomLocalConfig.get_setting]. Portions derived from func-godot (MIT License).

method.name: export_trenchbroom_settings
method.description: Writes current export folder paths to user://trenchbroom_config.json.

method.name: get_setting
method.description: Returns an export folder path from [code]user://trenchbroom_config.json[/code] for the given property.

method.name: reload_trenchbroom_settings
method.description: Reloads export folder paths from user://trenchbroom_config.json.
